verdict.rationale: Zep's governance docs say it applies authorization and audit controls to Context Graph operations. Dashboard users are governed by RBAC, while API keys and UserGroups use ABAC policies for least-privilege access by agents and Memory MCP users. Audit Logs record dashboard activity and API Logs record supported API request activity. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detail on how granular policies get for read versus write on specific graphs, and confirmation that API logging covers all memory read/write operations rather than only 'supported' requests.
